content.title: Academic Writing Task 1 — Process Diagram
content.description: A single Task 1 in 20 minutes: describe the process by which bricks are manufactured. Good for practising process language without sitting a full hour.

tasks.promptHtml:
The diagram below shows the process by which bricks are manufactured for the building industry.

Summarise the information by selecting and reporting the main features, and make comparisons where relevant.
